reference_sql:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with sales in 2025
  SELECT s.category_name, s.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales s
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id
  WHERE s.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND s.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.category_name, s.product_id, p.product_name
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per product with sales in 2025
  SELECT category_name, product_name, revenue,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM product_rev
)
SELECT category_name, product_name AS item, revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
UNION ALL
SELECT category_name, 'All other' AS item, SUM(revenue) AS revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rn > 3
GROUP BY category_name

WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with sales in 2025
  SELECT s.category_name, s.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales s
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id
  WHERE s.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND s.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.category_name, s.product_id, p.product_name
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per product with sales in 2025
  SELECT category_name, product_name, revenue,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_rev pr2
          WHERE pr2.category_name = pr.category_name
            AND (pr2.revenue > pr.revenue OR (pr2.revenue = pr.revenue AND pr2.product_id < pr.product_id))) AS ahead
  FROM product_rev pr
)
SELECT category_name, product_name AS item, revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE ahead < 3
UNION ALL
SELECT category_name, 'All other' AS item, SUM(revenue) AS revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE ahead >= 3
GROUP BY category_name

solver.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT category_name, product_id, product_name, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY category_name, product_id, product_name),
r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id) AS rn FROM p)
SELECT category_name, product_name AS item, revenue FROM r WHERE rn <= 3
UNION ALL
SELECT category_name, 'All other' AS item, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM r WHERE rn > 3 GROUP BY category_name
